args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Power adapter (if needed)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip flops
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Water bottle

ACTIVITIES-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Hiking gear for Diamond Head (sturdy shoes, water, hat)
- Modest clothing for Pearl Harbor visit
- Luau attire (aloha shirt/dress)
- Spa items for relaxation day
- Kayaking appropriate clothing

TOILETRIES:
- Personal medications
- Toiletries (shampoo, conditioner, etc.)
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Contact lenses/solution (if needed)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books/magazines for downtime
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Small backpack/day bag
- Umbrella or rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
- Insect repellent

Based on planned activities:
- June 11: Beach day at Waikiki Beach
- June 12: Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay
- June 13: Hiking at Diamond Head
- June 14: Visit to Pearl Harbor
- June 15: Road trip to the North Shore
- June 16: Luau experience at Polynesian Cultural Center
- June 17: Relaxation day at the hotel spa
- June 18: Kayaking at Kailua Beach
- June 19: Shopping at Ala Moana Center
- June 20: Departure
